translations.web: Yahweh said, “Judah shall go up. Behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.”
translations.bsb: “Judah shall go up,” answered the LORD. “Indeed, I have delivered the land into their hands.”
translations.kjv: And the LORD said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.
